effect.name: Flicker (Brightness and RGB)
effect.desc: Modulates layer brightness over time from a hash/value-noise generator with four flicker types (random, smooth random, pulse, random pulse), driven by Random Frequency, Phase, Bias, Smooth Random and Seed. Adds independent per-channel red/green/blue flicker, a step-gated strobe with adjustable width, and base brightness, contrast, saturation and blend controls.
